name: e1-below-control
note: THE CONTROL FOR E1: oblique-6's geometry, unchanged - the same 6 deg diamond centred ON the horizon - with the same Control/BelowAlignSuppress swept ABBA. The v0.85 suppression keys on alignFracH, horizon-referenced belowness, which is ~0 here, so this knob must have NO effect on this card. PASS: the two arms are indistinguishable - terminalOffDeg, rollYawOpposedPct and stickFlipRateR separate by less than the mirror-pair spread compare-runs.py reports for this card. FAIL: any arm separation at all; that is a regression, the suppression reaching a geometry it was never supposed to touch, and it also invalidates whatever e1-below-suppress measured. Fly it in the same session and on the same airframes as e1-below-suppress, DroneCount 1. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition.
